subject: Hosted API: exceptional discount request for Bluetide - approval needed
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@bluetide.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: exceptional discount request for Bluetide - approval needed

Hi Karthik / Marcus / Monica (looping finance),

Quick summary: Bluetide ran a 6-week POC on our hosted API for conversation summarization. They've asked for a 6-month usage commitment with a headline per-token discount off our published rate card to hit their procurement deadlines. Key ask from the buyer: a 30% off per-token effective rate on generation tokens for the first 6 months, with a soft commit of $150k net usage USD over that period.

Why this matters: Bluetide is a high-visibility fintech prospect (US-based) and a potential multi-year customer if we can move quickly. They expect final pricing to be confirmed before they start procurement next week (EOD Friday).

Attachments: Bluetide_usage-forecast.xlsx (detailed month-by-month), BT_MOU-draft.pdf (commercial terms).

Request: Can pricing/finance confirm whether we can approve a custom exception here? If so, outline constraints (timebox, minimum revenue, overage handling) we should include in the MOU.

I can jump on a quick call if helpful — Emma is on the thread.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@bluetide.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: exceptional discount request for Bluetide - approval needed

Naomi — thanks for the concise brief. A few requests before we can sign off: 

- Can you confirm the expected 6-month consumption cadence in the attached forecast (monthly token volumes)? The margin impact depends heavily on ramp.
- Is the $150k an ARR commit or consumption-based forecast? We need to know if it's a firm commit (reserved) or a best-effort target.
- What is the proposed billing model: usage-only at discounted per-token or a committed reserve with overage at discounted or list rates?

From a rate-card standpoint, our published hosted API per-token tiers are intended to cover typical SAS usage patterns; extraordinary 30% off will need a clear revenue floor or timebox. See current rate card: https://internal.redwood.com/pricing/hosted-ratecard (internal).

Marcus — can you run a quick margin calc if this is consumption-only vs committed $150k? If consumption-only, recommend we cap the discount period to 3 months and require a minimum billed volume of $100k to proceed.

Happy to take a short call today — I have a 12:30–1:15pm PT window.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@bluetide.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: exceptional discount request for Bluetide - approval needed

On Wed, Sep 2, 2026 at 11:05 AM Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Naomi — thanks for the concise brief. A few requests before we can sign off: 
> 
> - Can you confirm the expected 6-month consumption cadence in the attached forecast (monthly token volumes)? The margin impact depends heavily on ramp.
> - Is the $150k an ARR commit or consumption-based forecast? We need to know if it's a firm commit (reserved) or a best-effort target.
> - What is the proposed billing model: usage-only at discounted per-token or a committed reserve with overage at discounted or list rates?

Naomi / Karthik — ran a quick back-of-envelope on the two scenarios. If this is consumption-only with a 30% off list for 6 months, our blended margin drops below acceptable threshold (particularly on smaller monthly volumes). If it's a committed $150k minimum over 6 months, the math looks better but still tight.

Recommendation (conditional approval):
- Approve a 20% off list per-token discount for the first 3 months only.
- Require a minimum billed commitment of $100k over the 3-month period (if they hit the min, we retroactively apply the discount to the committed amount).
- After month 3, revert to list rates for overages; any extension of discount requires a formal review and renewal of commit.
- No changes to SLA or data residency in this approval — legal to advise on any exceptions.

If Naomi confirms that Bluetide will accept the 3-month structure and $100k floor, finance can approve and I will route to Legal/Contracts for the MOU updates and DocuSign.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Director, Finance — Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@bluetide.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: exceptional discount request for Bluetide - approval needed

Emma — thanks for your patience. Finance can approve a limited concession: 20% off list for the first 3 months with a $100k minimum billed commitment in that window. Overage will revert to standard rate card after month 3 unless we mutually agree an extension. Legal will update the MOU to reflect the timebox and billing floor.

Next steps for me:
- Update the MOU per Marcus' conditions and send to Legal for a quick review (attached: BT_MOU-draft.pdf updated).
- Send DocuSign package to Bluetide once Legal clears (DocuSign link will be shared).
- Confirm the HubSpot deal (BT-2026-09-01) will reflect the approved concession and revenue floor. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789

Emma — can you confirm that Bluetide is okay with the 3-month timebox and $100k floor? If yes, I'll push the MOU to Legal and circle back with a DocuSign by EOD tomorrow to meet your procurement timing.

Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Bluetide_usage-forecast.xlsx (updated), BT_MOU-draft.pdf (updated provisional language for discount and billing floor)
